connector.name: Prometiam Company Data

connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package prometiam-risk-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the matiasmaquieira96 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROMETIAM_API_KEY

env.name: PROMETIAM_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Default: https://api.prometiam.com/functions/v1/risk-api
